reasoning_content: I can see there's a networking folder. Let me check it.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check networking folder
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/client/src/networking/ 2>/dev/null")
print("Networking:", stdout.read().decode()[:1500])

# Check websocketClient
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("head -50 /opt/areloria/client/src/networking/websocketClient.ts 2>/dev/null")
print("\nWebsocketClient:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
